00073 #define FFTMagnitude_Docs @param input  The input signal to perform the FFT on, this should be mono  \
00074        @param fft   The FFTEngine to use. This can be just an int which will be  \
00075             used to create an FFTEngine or you can pass in an existing  \
00076             FFTEngine object. The FFT size should be a power of 2   \
00077             (if not, it will be rounded up to the next power of 2).   \
00078        @param overlap  Overlap factor for the FFT. E.g., if overlap is 2 and FFT size \
00079             is 1024, an FFT will be performed every 512 samples. This  \
00080             should be a small power of 2 (e.g., 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 etc).  \
00081        @param firstBin  The first bin index to report, 0 is the DC bin and the bin at \
00082             index equal to the FFT size is the Nyquist bin.     \
00083        @param numBins  The number of bins to report. The maximum if firstBin is zero \
00084             is equal to one greater than half the FFT size (e.g., if FFT \
00085             size is 128 the maximum is 65 assuming firstBin is zero).
00086

00097          (UGen const& input, FFTEngine const& fft, const int overlap, const int firstBin = 0, const int numBins = 0), 
00098         COMMON_UGEN_DOCS FFTMagnitude_Docs);
